name: AGIBOT A3
summary: A 1.73 m, 55 kg walking humanoid with 31 joints (hands not counted) and up to 10 h runtime with swappable batteries, built for stage shows, reception and research rather than handling work.

germany.statusNote: Generation Robots (France) sells the A3 online at EUR 88,600 excl. VAT with add-to-cart and 4-5 weeks delivery within the EU. Bipedal GmbH (Leverkusen) lists the A3 and an A3 Developer version as 'sofort verfügbar', price on request. The AGIBOT store lists it contact-only.

priceEur.note: Generation Robots, excl. VAT (EUR 106,320 incl. French VAT). A3 Ultra costs EUR 113,000 net at the same seller.

specs.label: Active DOF
specs.conditions: excluding hands: neck 2, arms 2 x 7, waist 3, legs 2 x 6

specs.label: Max walking speed
specs.conditions: everyday use; normal walking under 1.2 m/s; running up to 5 m/s

specs.label: Runtime
specs.conditions: up to, depending on workload (walking and standing)

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: 2 x RK3588 (interaction and motion control modules)

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Binocular RGB camera, shoulder touch sensors, 8-mic array, GPS and UWB positioning (under 10 cm)
specs.conditions: no LiDAR or depth camera listed

specs.label: Hands
specs.conditions: as listed by Bipedal; not counted in the 31 DOF

specs.label: Development
specs.value: Open interfaces; secondary development depends on the version (A3 Developer)
specs.conditions: Bipedal: standard version uses AGIBOT's released functions only, no platform-level secondary development

capabilities.sdk: Open interfaces; full secondary development only in the A3 Developer version
notes: Built for stage shows, events, reception and research; AGIBOT says application skills are not enabled by default and need secondary development.
Bipedal lists a silicone 'demonstration hand'; no gripping hand is listed for the standard A3 and the 31 DOF exclude hands.
The standard version runs AGIBOT's released functions; platform-level development needs the A3 Developer version.
No LiDAR, no IP rating published.
